user_query: I'm writing a research paper on email validation techniques and need to gather data on the accuracy of different API services. Can you provide me with the success rates and error codes of the Quick Email Verification and mailboxlayer APIs? Additionally, I would like to know the account information for my Blaze Verify API for comparison purposes.

TaskList.description: Gather success rates and error codes from the Quick Email Verification API.
Gather success rates and error codes from the mailboxlayer API.
Retrieve account information for the Blaze Verify API.
